text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
HAARETZ
- Arafat convening international converence to "rescue process".
- City official warns company: If you don't open mall on Sabbath, we will not grant Africa-Israel building permits in Tel Aviv.
- Airforce declined to press charges against officers after inquiry into rescue team disaster
- Likud activist David Appel acquitted from thievery charges
- Justice Bach: talk of religious elements taking over our lifestyle has no basis
JERUSALEM POST
- Hussein: PM's policy leading to bloodshed
- Netanyahu responds: I'm baffled by the personal attacks
- U.S. accepts Arafat invitation to Gaza conference
- MP's call for boycott on Migdal Insurance over Generali's refusal to pay holocaust victims
MAARIV
- The crisis deepens
- Israel opposes conference
- Hussein hung up phone on Netanyahu
- U.S. presses: freeze Har Homa
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH
- Netanyahu: we'll build in Jerusalem even if the whole world is against us
